exec patrolbot
cmp stdout help.golden

exec patrolbot --help
cmp stdout help.golden

exec patrolbot -h
cmp stdout help.golden

-- help.golden --

  patrolbot assists with patrolling MediaWiki sites.                                                                    
         
  USAGE  
         
    patrolbot [command] [--flags]  
            
  COMMANDS  
            
    config [command]  Manage bot configuration
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -c --config       Path to config file (default locations: ./config.yaml, $HOME/.patrolbot/config.yaml)
    -h --help         Help for patrolbot
    -v --version      Version for patrolbot
    -w --wiki         Target wiki for bot operations
